note: Head & Shoulders' anti-dandruff shampoos work through zinc pyrithione, an active that controls the fungus behind flaking - Noughty's To The Rescue range doesn't contain this, since it's formulated for dry and damaged hair rather than dandruff specifically. If dandruff control is what you actually need, this isn't a straight swap; look for a cruelty-free shampoo that lists zinc pyrithione or ketoconazole as an active. If you're using Head & Shoulders more out of habit than for a flaking scalp, Noughty uses a similarly gentle, sulphate-free cleansing base (cocamidopropyl betaine and coco-glucoside) with glycerin and vitamin E for moisture.
